The specification of US 10,144,532 states that the hybrid craft 'would move with great ease through the air / space / water mediums, by being enclosed in a vacuum plasma bubble / sheath, due to the coupled effects of EM field-induced air / water particles repulsion and vacuum energy polarization'. The board already carries that same sentence at Tier 1 from the Navy Case PAX 205 invention-disclosure briefing, which was obtained by a different route.

claims.text: THE NAVY'S SPONSORSHIP IS PRINTED ON THE FACE OF THE PATENT AND NOT INFERRED. US 10,144,532's front page carries, verbatim: '(73) Assignee: The United States of America as represented by the Secretary of the Navy, Washington, DC (US)'; '(74) Attorney, Agent, or Firm - Mark O Glut; NAWCAD'; and 'Primary Examiner - Philip J Bonzell'. The government did not merely take an assignment: it paid a NAWCAD attorney to prosecute the application, before the same examiner the board's existing Tier 1 claim names as the addressee of the Sheehy letter of 15 December 2017.

claims.text: A PATENT IS TIER 1 FOR WHAT IT CLAIMS AND NEVER FOR WHETHER THE THING WORKS, and what US 10,144,532 claims, in its own abstract: 'A craft using an inertial mass reduction device comprises of an inner resonant cavity wall, an outer resonant cavity, and microwave emitters. The electrically charged outer resonant cavity wall and the electrically insulated inner resonant cavity wall form a resonant cavity. The microwave emitters create high frequency electromagnetic waves throughout the resonant cavity causing the resonant cavity to vibrate in an accelerated mode and create a local polarized vacuum outside the outer resonant cavity wall.' The mechanism the specification gives is 'negative pressure (hence repulsive gravity) exhibited by the polarized local vacuum energy state'.
